{{Infobox person|name = Thomas J. Barton|education  = Lamar University|image = }}
'''Thomas J. Barton''' is an American chemist who served as the president of the [[American Chemical Society]] in 2014.<ref name="acs">{{cite web|url=http://cen.acs.org/articles/90/i37/President-Elect-Thomas-J-Barton.html|title=For President-Elect: Thomas J. Barton &#124; Chemical & Engineering News|publisher=cen.acs.org|accessdate=2014-07-13}}</ref>

==Biography==
He graduated from [[Lamar University]], and from [[University of Florida]] in 1967.
He was a post-doctoral fellow with [[National Institutes of Health]]  at the [[Ohio State University]].<ref name="iastate">{{cite web|url=http://www.chem.iastate.edu/faculty/Thomas_Barton/|title=Thomas J. Barton &#124; Department of Chemistry|publisher=chem.iastate.edu|accessdate=2014-07-13}}</ref>

He is a professor at [[Iowa State University]].
